target: Teach another learner to reason about imitation learning using a demonstrator-to-policy cloning trial. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

competency.title: Teach imitation learning — few shot
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about imitation learning using a demonstrator-to-policy cloning trial. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

topic_kernel.measure: success on unseen states and compounding error

competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a demonstrator-to-policy cloning trial.
competency.setting_constraint: Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include the example count, selection rule and learning curve.
Report success on unseen states and compounding error with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: evaluating only on demonstration trajectories.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of imitation learning.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report success on unseen states and compounding error against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for evaluating only on demonstration trajectories; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
